propositions: New binaries must write GET-rotation stamps to both .bridge_state/get_rotation.json (sidecar) and legacy inline bindings.json field, reading max(sidecar, legacy) to ensure compatibility across old and new binary versions.

Rotation state must be loaded from legacy inline field and persisted only through BindingStore.save(), covering end-of-pass, write-ahead, and recovery saves without creating the sidecar during reconcile-check with persist=False.
The get_rotation.py extracted module must remain cohesive and respect the 800-line policy for binding_store.py and outbound_differ.py while satisfying minimum-file requirements.
Explicit git staging must include GET_ROTATION_FILE via both reconcile_helpers.py staging list and basename membership checks, enabling sidecar-only commit without git add -A.
Interleaved old-binary and new-binary passes must produce identical rotation order as all-new sequences, and legacy-only stores must materialize equivalent sidecar state on persisted save.
